column1: # DEV-a: secret scan, shell history, long-command notification. Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column3: Secrets scan of the dotfiles (gitleaks, whole history)
column6: +pause cd ~/dotfiles && gitleaks git --no-banner --redact -v --exit-code 3 -c .gitleaks.toml . && echo "no secrets found"
column9: Runs the same rules as the pre-commit hook over every commit of the public dotfiles repo (values redacted). The hook itself only scans what you stage; bypass it only deliberately with git commit --no-verify.

ON = when a command that ran at least 30 s finishes while its terminal is not in front, a toast shows the command, exit status and duration; a click focuses that terminal and tmux pane. The threshold and the ignore list are at the top of ~/.config/zsh/cmd-hooks.zsh. Agent shells, ssh logins and commands starting with a space never notify; secret-looking commands show as hidden.
